name: Junior Volunteer Program, Northwell Manhattan Campus (Lenox Hill Hospital)
org: Northwell Health, Manhattan campus (Lenox Hill Hospital, Northwell Greenwich Village Hospital, Manhattan Eye, Ear & Throat Hospital)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital. You might be a lobby greeter, a friendly visitor or a music ambassador. You might help in the emergency room, office or radiology. You give comfort to patients and staff.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 16 at the Manhattan hospitals. Junior volunteers (ages 16 to 17) hand in working papers and a parent consent form. All applicants are interviewed, then there is a six-month trial period.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. No cost is listed.
duration: 100 hours per calendar year is required. Onboarding takes about 6 to 8 weeks.
deadline_text: Four sessions a year. Applications are due Mar 1 (spring), Jun 1 (summer), Sep 1 (fall) and Dec 1 (winter). Late applications are considered for the next session. The page gives the month and day but no year.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the Lenox Hill volunteer page. There is an interview. There is a required orientation. You also need a medical clearance. Questions? Write to manhattancampusvolunteers@northwell.edu.
notes: The page says junior volunteers (ages 16 to 17) must submit working papers and a parental consent form. Orientation and medical clearance are required. Volunteers 18 and older must pass a background screening. The page asks for 100 hours a year. The page gives a minimum age of 16 and no maximum age.
